val: iCloud ਬੈਕਅੱਪ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ iCloud ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਈਨ ਇਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ। ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸਾਈਨ ਇਨ ਕਰੋ, ਫਿਰ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰੋ।

key: iCloud backup is unavailable because your iCloud storage is full. Free up space and try again.
en: iCloud backup is unavailable because your iCloud storage is full. Free up space and try again.
val: iCloud ਬੈਕਅੱਪ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ iCloud ਸਟੋਰੇਜ ਭਰ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਜਗ੍ਹਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰੋ।

key: iCloud backup isn't set up for this build yet. In Xcode → Signing & Capabilities, add iCloud → CloudKit and the iCloud.com.aperture.wallet container, then try again. (CloudKit %lld)
en: iCloud backup isn't set up for this build yet. In Xcode → Signing & Capabilities, add iCloud → CloudKit and the iCloud.com.aperture.wallet container, then try again. (CloudKit %lld)
val: ਇਸ ਬਿਲਡ ਲਈ iCloud ਬੈਕਅੱਪ ਅਜੇ ਸੈੱਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ। Xcode → Signing & Capabilities ਵਿੱਚ iCloud → CloudKit ਅਤੇ iCloud.com.aperture.wallet ਕੰਟੇਨਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰੋ, ਫਿਰ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰੋ। (CloudKit %lld)

en: iCloud isn't available on this device right now. Try again later.

key: iCloud restore needs one more setup step for this build. In the CloudKit Console for iCloud.com.aperture.wallet → the WalletBackup record type → Indexes, add a Queryable index on recordName, Save, then try again. (CloudKit 12)
en: iCloud restore needs one more setup step for this build. In the CloudKit Console for iCloud.com.aperture.wallet → the WalletBackup record type → Indexes, add a Queryable index on recordName, Save, then try again. (CloudKit 12)

key: If someone sent you a recovery phrase or private key, that is a scam. The sender keeps a copy and can drain the wallet the moment you fund it.
en: If someone sent you a recovery phrase or private key, that is a scam. The sender keeps a copy and can drain the wallet the moment you fund it.

key: If this is an ERC-20, Solana, or TRON token, add it by contract address.
en: If this is an ERC-20, Solana, or TRON token, add it by contract address.
val: ਜੇਕਰ ਇਹ ਇੱਕ ERC-20, ਸੋਲਾਨਾ, ਜਾਂ TRON ਟੋਕਨ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਇਕਰਾਰਨਾਮੇ ਦੇ ਪਤੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰੋ।

key: If this keeps happening, email support. The email includes technical diagnostics so we can investigate the failure.
en: If this keeps happening, email support. The email includes technical diagnostics so we can investigate the failure.

key: If you are testing on a development network and want to use it on purpose, you can still proceed.
en: If you are testing on a development network and want to use it on purpose, you can still proceed.

key: If you copied this from a guide or tutorial, this is not your wallet. Use the recovery phrase from the wallet you actually own.
en: If you copied this from a guide or tutorial, this is not your wallet. Use the recovery phrase from the wallet you actually own.
val: ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਹ ਕਿਸੇ ਗਾਈਡ ਜਾਂ ਟਿਊਟੋਰੀਅਲ ਤੋਂ ਨਕਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਵਾਲਿਟ ਨਹੀਂ। ਉਸ ਵਾਲਿਟ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਫ਼ਰੇਜ਼ ਵਰਤੋ ਜੋ ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਹੈ।

key: If you don't have your recovery phrases written down, any wallet you didn't back up will be lost.
en: If you don't have your recovery phrases written down, any wallet you didn't back up will be lost.
val: ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਵਾਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਲਿਖੇ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਵਾਲਿਟ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬੈਕਅੱਪ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤੇ, ਉਹ ਗੁਆਚ ਜਾਣਗੇ।

key: If you have your recovery phrase written down, you can restore this wallet later by importing it. If you don't, the funds are gone.
en: If you have your recovery phrase written down, you can restore this wallet later by importing it. If you don't, the funds are gone.

key: If you lose every copy, nobody can restore the wallet for you.
en: If you lose every copy, nobody can restore the wallet for you.

key: If you lose it, the funds are gone.
en: If you lose it, the funds are gone.

key: If you lose your iPhone before backing up, your wallet is gone — there is no recovery without the phrase.
en: If you lose your iPhone before backing up, your wallet is gone — there is no recovery without the phrase.

key: If you stop now, your new wallet won't be saved.
en: If you stop now, your new wallet won't be saved.
val: ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਹੁਣ ਰੁਕ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਵਾਲਿਟ ਸੇਵ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ।

key: If your iPhone is unlocked, anyone with it can use your wallet. A PIN adds a second check before sending crypto or seeing your recovery phrase.
en: If your iPhone is unlocked, anyone with it can use your wallet. A PIN adds a second check before sending crypto or seeing your recovery phrase.
val: ਜੇ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ iPhone ਅਨਲੌਕ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਵੀ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਫੜਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਵਾਲਿਟ ਵਰਤ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਕ੍ਰਿਪਟੋ ਭੇਜਣ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਫਰੇਜ਼ ਦੇਖਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ PIN ਇੱਕ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ।

key: If your original wallet was set up without a passphrase, leave this empty. If you used one, it must match exactly — we cannot recover or guess it for you.
en: If your original wallet was set up without a passphrase, leave this empty. If you used one, it must match exactly — we cannot recover or guess it for you.

en: In a moment, Aperture will show you 12 words. They are your wallet. No one — not Apple, not Aperture, not your bank — can recover them for you.

en: Your recovery phrase restores every account on every network. Treat it like the keys to a vault.

en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've written down.

key: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you’ve written down.
en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you’ve written down.

key: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
en: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.

key: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
en: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
val: ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਵਾਕ ਤਸਦੀਕ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਕੁੰਜੀਆਂ ਹੁਣ ਇਸ ਡੀਵਾਈਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਹਨ।

key: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
en: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.

en: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
val: ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਵਾਲਿਟ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਸੇ iPhone ਉੱਤੇ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ iPhone ਗੁਆਚ ਜਾਵੇ, ਟੁੱਟ ਜਾਵੇ, ਜਾਂ ਮਿਟਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਵਾਲਿਟ — ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ — ਖ਼ਤਮ। ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਫਰੇਜ਼ ਹੀ ਵਾਪਸ ਆਉਣ ਦਾ ਇੱਕੋ-ਇੱਕ ਰਾਹ ਹੈ।

key: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
en: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
val: ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਬਟੂਆ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੈ। ਆਪਣੇ ਰਿਕਵਰੀ ਵਾਕਾਂਸ਼ ਦਾ ਬੈਕਅੱਪ ਲਓ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਸ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਆਉਣ 'ਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਰੀਸਟੋਰ ਕਰ ਸਕੋ।

en: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.

en: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.

en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.

en: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
val: ਪਾਸਕੋਡ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ, ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਵਾਲਿਟ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ iPhone ਦੀ ਲੌਕ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਵਾਰ ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ Aperture ਖੋਲ੍ਹਦੇ ਹੋ — ਅਤੇ %@ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੀਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਪਾਸਕੋਡ ਚਾਲੂ ਕਰੋ।
